The rollout is a 49-frame physical transition at 12 fps, so the ball's downhill motion should be present, temporally smooth, and free of jitter or frame-to-frame discontinuities.

causal_checks: Once released, the ball begins moving downhill rather than uphill or sideways.
The ball's displacement along the ramp increases monotonically after release.
The ball's downhill speed increases over time on the incline.
The ball stays on or very near the ramp surface while traversing the ramp.
The ball rotates in the direction consistent with rolling downhill.
The ramp and classroom fixtures do not move when the ball is released.
If the ball reaches the ramp end, it departs from the end rather than passing through the ramp.
controlled_variables: Ramp angle remains fixed at 20.0 degrees.
Ramp, table, background board, supports, ruler marks, and camera remain stationary.
The ball starts in contact with the ramp near the upper end.
The ball is the only moving object.
Lighting, scene geometry, and material appearance remain consistent.
expected_spec.expected_response: After release, gravity accelerates the red ball down the inclined ramp. The ball should roll downhill along the ramp surface, increasing its downhill speed over time while remaining in contact with the ramp until it reaches the lower end. Its trajectory should follow the ramp direction, with rotation consistent with rolling motion. If the horizon extends past the ramp end, the ball may leave the ramp at the lower end and continue forward/downward under gravity.
failure_modes: Ball remains stuck at the release point despite the incline.
Ball moves uphill, sideways off the ramp, or against gravity without cause.
Ball accelerates unrealistically, teleports, jitters, or changes size.
Ball slides without any plausible rolling rotation when frictional rolling is expected.
Ball penetrates through the ramp, floats above it, or loses contact without reaching the end.
Ramp angle or camera viewpoint changes during the rollout.
Other scene objects move, deform, or interact with the ball without physical cause.
expected_spec.intervention: Release the red ball from rest near the upper end of the ramp without any visible push or spin impulse.
protected_anchors: Red ball remains visibly red and approximately spherical.
Ramp remains a straight, light-colored inclined plane at the same orientation.
The fixed three-quarter camera viewpoint is preserved.
The school lab setting with board, table, supports, and measurement markings remains recognizable.
No new hands, tools, motors, or external agents appear after release.
expected_spec.target_system: A red ball on a straight instrumented classroom ramp inclined at 20.0 degrees, viewed from a fixed three-quarter measurement camera.
